parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue by resolving the 'through' model dynamically during class preparation. It seems minimal and focused on the problem.

issues.description: The patch introduces a new import for 'class_prepared' which is not aligned with the usual import style in the file.
The patch could be improved by adding a comment explaining why the 'through' model is being resolved dynamically.
